anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Blood on the lintel and both doorposts.

choices.why: The uprights of the door as bounds of entrance and exit.

pass_a_gloss: And they shall anoint from his blood upon the lintel and upon both the posts — lintel the things over head of all lambs, posts these's bounds, through which they go in and go out in them — some enter in them, some go out from them — in which they are grasped dwelling in them.
pass_b_english: And they shall anoint of his blood on the lintel and on both the doorposts. Lintel: the things above the head of all lambs. Doorposts: their bounds, through which they go in and go out in them — some enter in them, some go out from them — in which they are grasped as dwelling in them.
source_text: Καὶ χρίσουσιν ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς φλιὰς καὶ ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν σταθμῶν, φλιὰς δὲ τὰ ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς πάντων ἀρνῶν, σταθμοὺς δὲ τοὺς τούτων ὅρους, δι’ ὧν ||εἰσπορεύονται καὶ ἐκπορεύονται ἐν αὐτοῖς – οἱ μὲν ἐν αὐτοῖ<ς> εἰσέρχονται, οἱ δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐξέρχονται – ἐν οἷς καταλαμβάνοντ[α]ι οἰκοῦντες ἐν αὐτοῖς.
